title: McConnell invites Kirkpatrick to Senate interviews and the Fugal briefing
place_text: Senate Armed Services Committee hearing room

tellings.quote: I invited him with some regularity to sit in on our interviews of uh of Navy pilots and and some of the scientific figures.

plain: A Senate staffer named Kirk McConnell, who worked for the Senate committee that oversees the military, says he regularly invited Sean Kirkpatrick, head of the Pentagon's office for investigating UFO reports, to sit in on his interviews with Navy pilots and scientists, and to a briefing by Brandon Fugal, a businessman who owns a ranch known for strange events. McConnell tells Michels this first-hand: "I invited him with some regularity to sit in on our interviews." The point is that the official in charge was shown the same witnesses Congress heard.
